extract_student_records.description: Retrieve a student's academic record (CGPA, semester, department, status) by roll number.
extract_student_records.limitations: Currently returns simulated institutional data; not yet connected to a live student records database.

fetch_drive_spreadsheet.description: Read rows from a Google Sheets spreadsheet by spreadsheet ID and range.
fetch_drive_spreadsheet.limitations: No Google service-account credentials are configured at uri_workspace/credentials.json; falls back to mock data until they are.

draft_institutional_note.description: Draft a concise NIT Sikkim administrative office noting from a request description.
draft_institutional_note.limitations: Drafting only; does not submit, approve, or file the noting anywhere.

draft_institutional_order.description: Draft a formal NIT Sikkim administrative Office Order from a request description.
draft_institutional_order.limitations: Drafting only; does not issue, sign, or distribute the order.

pc_system_optimization.description: Inspect and optimize this device's performance (e.g. startup programs, disk/temp cleanup, resource-heavy processes) with explicit user approval before any change.
pc_system_optimization.limitations: No execution adapter exists yet; this entry exists so URI can explain the gap honestly rather than pretend the capability is available. See the Controlled Self-Development architecture (research -> propose -> approve -> test -> approve -> execute -> verify -> rollback) for how this would eventually be built - none of that pipeline exists yet either.
